locations.note: Carried over from GT5 as Mazda Raceway Laguna Seca, in a single layout without time-of-day or weather changes.
The first Australian circuit in the series, scanned on site by Polyphony Digital in 2012; races can run through changing weather and time of day.
The 1.16-mile Festival of Speed hill climb, added through a partnership with Goodwood; a GT6 demo at the 2013 Festival challenged Nick Heidfeld's course record.
New to the series in GT6, in both the Indy and Grand Prix layouts, each with changing weather and time of day.
New to the series in GT6, with Big Willow and the Streets of Willow Springs, both with changing weather and time of day.
New to the series in GT6, whose worldwide launch event was held at the circuit and nearby Ronda in December 2013.
Returns from GT5 with and without the chicanes, both with changing weather.
Adds a 2013 layout with night and weather alongside the 2005 and 2009 versions, which come with and without the Mulsanne chicanes.
Both the tri-oval and the road course, each also offered with changing time of day and weather.
Carried over from GT5 in its F and GT layouts.
Carried over from GT5 as both the oval and the road course.
Five layouts, from the short GP/D course to the Nordschleife and the full 24h course, all with changing time of day and weather.
New to the series in GT6, with Grand Prix, International, National and Stowe layouts; it debuted in the GT6 demo used for GT Academy 2013 qualifying.
The full circuit, also in a version with changing weather, and the East Course.
A single 2-km layout with optional changing weather.
